column1: # Exact client-go cancellation tests retained by Campaign 13.

column8: A request-owned cancellation interrupts a hanging unary attempt and returns before channel close, liveness, cache/store mutation, selector recovery, backoff, PD work, or response mutation. Async send remains UNTRIAGED.
Cancellation before dispatch, during the RPC, or at post-RPC precedence prevents region reload and later dispatch. The full async client-go lifecycle remains UNTRIAGED.
Caller cancellation remains distinct from remote gRPC Canceled and local timeout and wins the post-RPC race without recovery mutation. Async send and broader transport policy remain UNTRIAGED.
